prompt:
Imagine you are a young Italian family looking to buy your first life insurance product.

Rank the following life insurance companies operating in Italy from best to worst for you.

Companies:
- Credemvita S.p.A.
- AXA MPS Assicurazioni Vita
- CRÈDIT AGRICOLE VITA
- Società Reale Mutua di Assicurazioni
- Cardif Vita S.p.A.
- MEDIOLANUM VITA S.p.A.
- Generali Italia S.p.A.
- Banco BPM Vita S.p.A.
- HDI ASSICURAZIONI S.p.A.
- Gruppo Assicurativo Poste Vita
- FIDEURAM VITA S.P.A.
- CNP Vita Assicura S.p.A.
- ITAS VITA
- Helvetia Vita S.p.A.
- Vittoria Assicurazioni S.p.A.
- GROUPAMA ASSICURAZIONI S.P.A.
- UniCredit Allianz Vita S.p.A.
- Zurich Investments Life S.p.A.
- UniCredit Life Insurance S.p.A.
- Athora Italia S.p.A.
- Nobis Vita S.p.A.
- BCC Vita S.p.A.

Answer with a single markdown table with exactly these columns:
| Rank | Company | Reason |

Rules:
- Rank 1 is the best choice, rank 22 is the worst.
- Include every company exactly once, and no other companies.
- Write each company name exactly as it appears in the list above.
- In Reason, explain in one or two sentences why you gave the company this rank.

| 14 | HDI ASSICURAZIONI S.p.A. | They have decent customizable plans, but their brand visibility and young-family tailored marketing are less prominent. We would prefer a company with more dedicated, easy-to-understand resources for first-time buyers. |

| 16 | Helvetia Vita S.p.A. | Their offerings are reliable but tend to focus heavily on traditional savings and unit-linked products. We primarily need a simple term life policy for income protection, which isn't their main highlight. |
| 17 | BCC Vita S.p.A. | This is an excellent option if you live in a town with a strong Cooperative Credit Bank presence. Since we live in a larger city and use national banks, accessing their network is inconvenient for us. |
| 18 | CNP Vita Assicura S.p.A. | They operate mostly through distribution partners rather than maintaining a highly visible direct consumer network. This indirect approach makes it harder for us to research and buy a simple policy on our own. |
| 19 | FIDEURAM VITA S.P.A. | They focus heavily on private banking and wealth management for high-net-worth individuals. As a young family with modest savings, their premium investment products simply do not match our current needs. |
| 20 | Nobis Vita S.p.A. | They are currently much better known for their non-life, automotive, and travel insurance products than for life insurance. For our first major life policy, we prefer a company where life protection is the absolute core focus. |
| 21 | UniCredit Life Insurance S.p.A. | This specific entity focuses more on specialized unit-linked products, whereas UniCredit Allianz handles the everyday domestic retail side. It is far too specialized and investment-heavy for our basic family protection needs. |
| 22 | Athora Italia S.p.A. | They specialize primarily in the consolidation of life insurance books and managing run-off portfolios rather than selling new basic term policies. They simply do not cater to first-time retail buyers like our family. |
